blocks.title: Know where a symbol lives — and who calls it
blocks.description: as-codemap scans the workspace into a symbol-and-reference map, so the AI can answer navigation questions about your own codebase instead of guessing.

items.title: Symbol index
items.description: Functions, classes, methods, interfaces and constants, each with its file and line.

items.title: Reference counts
items.description: How often each symbol is used, aggregated across files.

items.title: Two agent tools
items.description: code_graph_build rescans the workspace; code_graph_query searches by name and kind.

items.title: Code Map view
items.description: A workspace view lists the scanned files and symbols for one-click lookup.

showcase.user_prompt: Build the code map, then tell me where buildSummary is called.
showcase.assistant_reply: Code map built: 128 files, 913 symbols. buildSummary — src/summary.ts:14, 3 references.

items.title: Ask the AI to build the code map
items.description: Say “build the code map”; the scan covers the workspace of the current session.

items.title: Open the Code Map view
items.description: Scanned files and symbols appear in the panel; ask follow-up questions in the same conversation.

blocks.content: The parser is lexical rather than type-aware: identically named locals can be over-matched, and very large files (over 512 KB or 5000 lines) are skipped.
